text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product photograph on pure white seamless background, soft neutral studio light, entire items visible, realistic materials. No person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin, hanger, stand, typography, logos or watermark. A fitted black fine-knit mock-neck long-sleeve top, a subtle angular cap-like shoulder overlay that extends beyond the sleeve heads, fitted waist with natural fabric folds. Washed charcoal-black skinny jeans with gray thigh fading and brown topstitching tucked into tall black leather boots extending just above the knee, gently slouched shafts, asymmetric raised front tops, crossed leather straps with small aged metal side buckles, pointed toes and modest heels. Preserve the reference silhouette and visible construction. Include narrow silver-chain black belt at low waist, small taupe-gray faux-fur charm at viewer right hip, small silver hoop/drop earrings and a tiny silver nose stud displayed separately above shoulders.
original_prompt: Reference defines clothing/accessory design only. Create one photorealistic product image, pure white seamless background, portrait 2:3, soft neutral studio lighting, realistic materials, whole item visible with margins. No person, skin, face, hair, braids, visible mannequin, stand, hanger, typography or watermark. Preserve visible reference design; do not invent decoration. Create a complete frontal ghost-mannequin outfit arranged coherently as worn, wearer totally invisible. A fitted black fine-knit mock-neck long-sleeve top, a subtle angular cap-like shoulder overlay that extends beyond the sleeve heads, fitted waist with natural fabric folds. Washed charcoal-black skinny jeans with gray thigh fading and brown topstitching tucked into tall black leather boots extending just above the knee, gently slouched shafts, asymmetric raised front tops, crossed leather straps with small aged metal side buckles, pointed toes and modest heels. Preserve the reference silhouette and visible construction. Include narrow silver-chain black belt at low waist, small taupe-gray faux-fur charm hanging at viewer right hip. Two small silver hoop earrings with short pointed drops and one tiny silver nose stud float neatly in white space above the empty neckline, without any hair or head. Do not add purse or necklace.
